title: After Rotator Cuff Repair — Protect the Repair, Then Rebuild the Shoulder

hook.en: A repaired rotator cuff tendon is stitched to bone, and it takes months to heal. Push too hard too early and the repair can fail; hold back too long and the shoulder stiffens. Learn the phased plan surgeons and physiotherapists use, and how to tell normal soreness from a warning sign.
hook.ur: Marammat shuda rotator cuff tendon haddi se sila jata hai, aur theek hone mein mahine lagte hain. Bohat jaldi zyada zor lagayein to marammat naakaam ho sakti hai; bohat der rokein to kandha akar jata hai. Woh marhala war plan seekhein jo surgeons aur physiotherapists istemal karte hain, aur normal soreness ko warning sign se alag karna.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain why the repair needs protection, follow the four phases from sling to strength, choose passive, active-assisted and active exercises at the right time, and recognise signs of a failed repair or infection.
goal.ur: End tak aap samjhayenge ke marammat ko hifazat kyun chahiye, sling se taqat tak chaar marahil follow karenge, sahi waqt par passive, active-assisted aur active exercises chunenge, aur naakaam marammat ya infection ki alamaat pehchanenge.

text.en: In a **rotator cuff repair**, the torn tendon (most often **supraspinatus**) is reattached to the humerus with anchors and sutures. **Tendon-to-bone healing is slow**: the repair is weakest in the first weeks and needs about **12 weeks** to become reasonably strong, with remodelling for months after that. Rehab follows phases: **protection** in a sling with passive movement, then **active-assisted and active** movement, then **strengthening**, then **return to full activity**. Timings depend on **tear size, tissue quality and the surgeon's protocol** — always follow the operation note.
text.ur: **Rotator cuff repair** mein phata hua tendon (aksar **supraspinatus**) anchors aur taankon se humerus se dobara joda jata hai. **Tendon se haddi ka judna aahista hota hai**: marammat pehle hafton mein sab se kamzor hoti hai aur theek mazboot hone mein takreeban **12 hafte** lagte hain, us ke baad mahinon tak remodelling. Rehab marahil follow karta hai: sling mein passive harkat ke saath **hifazat**, phir **active-assisted aur active** harkat, phir **strengthening**, phir **poori activity mein wapsi**. Waqt **tear ke size, tissue ki quality aur surgeon ke protocol** par munhasir hai — hamesha operation note follow karein.

text.en: A new cuff repair is like **glue setting on a wall bracket**. You can gently move the shelf so it does not seize up, but you must not hang heavy books on it until the glue has fully set. Strengthening too early is hanging the books on wet glue.
text.ur: Naya cuff repair **diwaar ke bracket par jamti gond** jaisa hai. Aap shelf ko narmi se hila sakte hain taake akre nahi, magar gond poori tarah jamne tak us par bhaari kitaben nahi latka sakte. Bohat jaldi strengthening geeli gond par kitaben latkana hai.

title.en: The four phases (typical; follow the surgeon)
title.ur: Chaar marahil (aam taur par; surgeon ko follow karein)

steps.title: Phase 1 — protection (about 0 to 6 weeks)
steps.detail: Sling most of the time; elbow, wrist and hand exercises; pendulums and passive shoulder movement by the therapist or the other arm within the limits set. No active lifting of the arm, no lifting or pushing. || Marhala 1 — hifazat (takreeban 0 se 6 hafte)

steps.title: Phase 2 — active-assisted to active (about 6 to 12 weeks)
steps.detail: Wean the sling; table slides, wand or pulley exercises, then active elevation in comfortable ranges; scapular control. Restore range before strength. || Marhala 2 — active-assisted se active (takreeban 6 se 12 hafte)

steps.title: Phase 3 — strengthening (about 12 weeks onwards)
steps.detail: Light bands and weights for rotator cuff and scapular muscles, progressing load gradually; functional tasks at waist then shoulder height. || Marhala 3 — strengthening (takreeban 12 hafte se)

steps.title: Phase 4 — return to full activity (about 4 to 6 months onwards)
steps.detail: Heavier lifting, overhead work and sport, guided by strength and control rather than the date. Full recovery often takes 6 to 12 months. || Marhala 4 — poori activity mein wapsi (takreeban 4 se 6 mahine se)

question.en: Why is active lifting of the arm avoided in the first weeks after cuff repair?
question.ur: Cuff repair ke baad pehle hafton mein bazu khud uthane se kyun bacha jata hai?

feedback.en: The joint is not dislocated after a cuff repair.
feedback.ur: Cuff repair ke baad joint utra hua nahi hota.

text.en: To keep the shoulder stiff on purpose
text.ur: Kandhe ko jaan boojh kar akra rakhne ke liye

feedback.en: Gentle passive movement is used to prevent stiffness.
feedback.ur: Akrapan rokne ke liye narm passive harkat istemal hoti hai.

text.en: The tendon-to-bone repair is weakest early and active contraction could pull it apart
text.ur: Tendon se haddi ki marammat shuru mein sab se kamzor hoti hai aur active contraction isay alag kar sakta hai

feedback.en: Yes — the repaired muscle must not work hard until it has healed enough.
feedback.ur: Haan — marammat shuda muscle ko kaafi theek hone tak zor se kaam nahi karna chahiye.

rows.en: Therapist, the other arm or a pendulum swing; the repaired muscle relaxes
rows.ur: Therapist, doosra bazu ya pendulum; marammat shuda muscle dheela

rows.en: The patient helps with a wand, pulley or table slide
rows.ur: Mareez wand, pulley ya table slide se madad karta hai

rows.en: The patient lifts the arm alone

text.en: **Range first, then strength; follow the note.** Restore movement before loading, and never move faster than the surgeon's protocol for that tear.
text.ur: **Pehle range, phir taqat; note follow karein.** Load se pehle harkat bahal karein, aur us tear ke liye surgeon ke protocol se tez kabhi na barhein.

text.en: **Using the same timeline for every cuff repair.** A small tear in good tissue and a massive tear in a smoker with poor tissue need very different speeds. Read the operation note (tear size, number of tendons, tissue quality) and agree the plan with the surgeon.
text.ur: **Har cuff repair ke liye ek hi timeline.** Achhe tissue mein chhota tear aur kamzor tissue wale cigarette noshi mein bara tear bohat mukhtalif raftaar maangte hain. Operation note parhein (tear ka size, tendons ki tadaad, tissue ki quality) aur surgeon ke saath plan tay karein.

question.en: At 3 weeks, which exercise is usually appropriate?
question.ur: 3 hafte par aam taur par kaun si exercise munasib hai?

text.ur: Sar se ooper 2 kg wazan uthana

feedback.en: Far too early: this loads the healing repair.
feedback.ur: Bohat jaldi: yeh theek hoti marammat par load daalta hai.
Resisted kaam bohat baad mein shuru hota hai.

text.en: Pendulums and passive elevation within the surgeon's limits
text.ur: Surgeon ki hadd mein pendulums aur passive elevation

feedback.en: Yes — passive movement protects the repair and prevents stiffness.
feedback.ur: Haan — passive harkat marammat ki hifazat karti hai aur akrapan rokti hai.

question.en: At 10 weeks the patient cannot actively lift the arm at all, though passive range is good, after feeling a "give" while lifting. What should you suspect?
question.ur: 10 hafte par mareez bazu bilkul khud nahi utha sakta, halanke passive range achhi hai, bazu uthate hue "kuch hatne" ke ehsaas ke baad. Kis cheez ka shak karna chahiye?

feedback.ur: Akrapan passive range bhi kam karta hai.

feedback.en: The history of a "give" points to structural failure.
feedback.ur: "Hatne" ki history structural naakaami ki taraf ishara karti hai.

text.en: A re-tear or failed repair — inform the surgeon
text.ur: Dobara tear ya naakaam marammat — surgeon ko batayein

feedback.en: Yes — sudden loss of active lift with good passive range suggests failure.
feedback.ur: Haan — achhi passive range ke saath achanak active uthane ka khatam hona naakaami dikhata hai.

text.en: **Teach sling and sleeping skills.** Show how to put the sling on and off, dress the operated arm first, and keep the elbow slightly forward of the body when lying (a pillow under the arm). Many patients sleep better semi-reclined for the first weeks. Ice and prescribed pain relief before exercise make passive work easier.
text.ur: **Sling aur sone ki maharat sikhayein.** Sling pehenna aur utarna dikhayein, operation wale bazu ko pehle kapre pehnayein, aur letne mein kohni ko jism se thora aage rakhein (bazu ke neeche takiya). Bohat se mareez pehle hafton mein adh-lete hue behtar sote hain. Exercise se pehle barf aur likhi hui dard ki dawai passive kaam aasan banati hai.

question.en: Why do some cuff repairs fail even with good rehab?
question.ur: Achhe rehab ke bawajood kuch cuff repairs naakaam kyun hote hain?

answer.en: Failure is more likely with large or massive tears, older age, poor tendon quality and fatty change in the muscle, smoking, diabetes, and a long delay between tear and surgery. Many re-tears happen in the first 3 to 6 months. Some patients with a re-tear still have acceptable function, so the surgeon decides what to do.
answer.ur: Naakaami bare ya bohat bare tears, zyada umar, tendon ki kamzor quality aur muscle mein charbi ki tabdeeli, cigarette noshi, diabetes, aur tear aur surgery ke darmiyan lambe waqfe ke saath zyada mumkin hai. Bohat se dobara tears pehle 3 se 6 mahine mein hote hain. Kuch dobara tear wale mareezon ka function phir bhi qabil-e-qabool hota hai, is liye surgeon faisla karta hai ke kya karna hai.

beats.patient: A 58-year-old carpenter had arthroscopic repair of a medium supraspinatus tear 2 weeks ago. He is in a sling, has moderate night pain and asks when he can go back to work. His operation note allows passive movement to 90 degrees elevation for 6 weeks.
beats.assessment: He is in phase 1; the repair is still weak and his heavy, overhead job is months away.
beats.treatment: Pendulums and passive elevation to 90 degrees, elbow-wrist-hand exercises, sling and sleep advice, pain control; plan phases with the surgeon; light duties possibly at around 3 months and heavy work at about 6 months, depending on strength.
beats.reassess: At 4 months he has full active range and good strength at waist height, starts light work, and returns to full carpentry at 7 months.

text.en: **Contact the surgeon promptly** for a sudden loss of active movement or a "pop" (possible re-tear), wound redness, discharge or fever (possible infection), increasing pain at rest that does not settle, or a swollen, painful arm or calf (possible clot). New numbness or weakness in the hand also needs review.
text.ur: **Surgeon se jaldi rabta karein** active harkat achanak khatam hone ya "pop" (mumkina dobara tear), zakhm mein surkhi, pani ya bukhar (mumkina infection), aaram mein barhte dard jo theek na ho, ya soojhe, dardnak bazu ya pindli (mumkina clot) par. Haath mein naya sunn-pan ya kamzori ko bhi jaanch chahiye.

summary.en: A cuff repair heals slowly tendon-to-bone and needs about 12 weeks to become reasonably strong.
summary.ur: Cuff repair tendon se haddi tak aahista theek hota hai aur theek mazboot hone mein takreeban 12 hafte lagte hain.

summary.en: Phases: protection with passive movement (0 to 6 weeks), active-assisted to active (6 to 12), strengthening (12 onwards), return to full activity (4 to 6 months onwards) — always per the surgeon's note.
summary.ur: Marahil: passive harkat ke saath hifazat (0 se 6 hafte), active-assisted se active (6 se 12), strengthening (12 se), poori activity mein wapsi (4 se 6 mahine se) — hamesha surgeon ke note ke mutabiq.

summary.en: Sudden loss of active lift, signs of infection or a clot need prompt review by the surgical team.
summary.ur: Active uthane ka achanak khatam hona, infection ya clot ki alamaat surgical team ki jaldi jaanch maangti hain.
